entities.name: Sliver Overlord
entities.description: Ultimate sliver formed from surviving slivers fusing into the hive mind, created in 4306 AR.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Hive-mind creatures recreated by the Riptide Project after their extinction.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: Slivers' deceased queen, not recreated by the Riptide wizards.

entities.name: Riptide Project
entities.description: Group of wizards that recreated the slivers.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Artifact whose magical waves wreaked havoc across Otaria and lured the slivers.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Creature created in the magical explosion at Averru.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: Site of the battle where most slivers were killed.

entities.name: Apocalypse
entities.description: Event during which slivers went extinct.

events.summary: The Riptide Project recreates the slivers but not the Sliver Queen, and the slivers overrun the Riptide island.
events.quote: In her absence the slivers went rampant and overran the Riptide island.

events.summary: The Mirari's waves lure the slivers to the mainland, and most die at Averru in the explosion that created Karona.
events.quote: were killed in the magical explosion that created Karona

events.summary: A small group of surviving slivers fuses into the Sliver Overlord.
events.quote: A small group of slivers survived however

events.summary: After Karona's death the Overlord is believed to have separated, and the slivers lost their leadership.
events.quote: after Karona's death the Overlord was separated

relations.quote: The Riptide Project recreated slivers after their extinction during the Apocalypse
